description: This file defines an abstract class RuntimeConfig for managing Spark runtime configurations, including methods for setting, getting, and checking configuration properties, as well as handling external configuration entries.

classes.name: RuntimeConfig
classes.description: An abstract class providing an interface for managing Spark runtime configurations, including methods to set, get, unset, and check modifiability of configuration properties.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a Spark runtime configuration property with a String value.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Overloaded method to set a configuration property with a Boolean value, converting it to String.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Overloaded method to set a configuration property with a Long value, converting it to String.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a configuration property using a ConfigEntry and a value of generic type T.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a configuration property by key, throws if not set and no default.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a configuration property by key, returning a default if not set.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a configuration property using a ConfigEntry, throws if not set.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a configuration property using an OptionalConfigEntry, returns None if not set.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a configuration property using a ConfigEntry, with a user-defined default.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a configuration key is set.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns all set configuration properties as a Map.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Returns an Option containing the value of a configuration property if set.

methods.name: unset
methods.description: Resets/removes a configuration property by key.

methods.name: isModifiable
methods.description: Checks if a configuration property is modifiable in the current session.
